title: QuartoInstallations
description:
This defines the top-level object that describes the data returned by the server.
It contains information about each installation of Quarto that is known.

installations.description:
The array of information about Posit Connect's Quarto
installations.

QuartoInstallation.description: This defines the information provided by the server about a single installation of Quarto.

version.description: The version number of this Quarto installation.

cluster_name.description:
The cluster that contains this Quarto installation.
A value of `Local` indicates that the Quarto installation is local to the
Posit Connect server.

image_name.description:
The image that contains this Quarto installation.
A value of `Local` indicates that the Quarto installation is local to the
Posit Connect server.
